[[File:APPBlasterBox.png|thumb|right|250px|[[BL-17]] using a AAP-II blaster box.]]
The '''AAP blaster box''',<ref name="AAP blaster box">{{CSWECite|I|5|AAP blaster box}}</ref> also known as a '''laser-cannon harness''',<ref name="Droid World">[[Star Wars (1977) 47|''Star Wars'' (1977) 47]]</ref> was a series of [[Laser/Legends|laser]] weapons manufactured by [[Briletto Company]] that were designed to be affixed to most kinds of [[Droid/Legends|droids]] without the need for extensive reprogramming or retrofitting. They were typically strapped to the chest and unlike the [[Reciprocating quad blaster cannon/Legends|reciprocating quad blaster cannon]] were not meant to be used by organics. Models of AAP blaster boxes included the [[AAP-II blaster box|AAP-II]] and [[AAP-IV blaster box|AAP-IV]].<ref name="AAP blaster box" />
